verdict.rationale: n8n ships its own MCP Server Trigger node, which a probe identifies as the official MCP server. This is the product itself exposing workflows as MCP tools that external agents can call. Evidence is limited to the doc page title and the probe pointer. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how workflows or connected app actions are exposed as tools, auth and transport details for external agent clients, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose my workflows or connected app actions as MCP tools that an external agent can call
